# Third-party runtime

Pyodide 0.27.7 is vendored from its official release distribution. See
pyodide/LICENSE. Package versions and checksums are recorded in
pyodide/pyodide-lock.json and pyodide/vendor-manifest.json.

pandas, NumPy, python-dateutil, pytz, and six are distributed as their original
wheels. Their license and copyright notices remain inside the wheels' dist-info
directories. Python's own license is retained in the Pyodide distribution.

The app's intake CSS and interaction code were written for this project from the
brief's design specification. No ABAS-3 source code was copied.
